tagline: Wavetable bass synth with upright and electric tones
description: An 8-voice bass instrument built on two fixed additive wavetables, one for upright and one for electric bass. Each note sums a part that holds while the key is down with a brighter part that fades away, plus an optional noise click at the start, through a one-pole low-pass tone control. Nothing is physically modelled or sampled; use it for simple synthesized bass lines.

features.name: Bass Type
features.description: Upright uses a five-partial wavetable weighted to the fundamental; Electric uses six partials with stronger upper harmonics.

features.name: Play Style
features.description: Fingered, Picked and Slapped set how loud the fading attack part starts (0.7, 1.0 or 1.3 times velocity) against the held part.

features.name: Decay
features.description: Sets how quickly the attack part fades while the note is held; the held part sustains until note-off.

features.name: Fret Noise
features.description: Adds a white-noise burst about 2 ms long at the start of each note, scaled by the 0-1 Fret Noise amount.

features.name: Tone
features.description: A one-pole low-pass whose cutoff rises with the 0-1 Tone control, from dark to nearly open.
